step: Acknowledge alarm and read trends before acting
why: Diagnosis starts with data, not with tools.

step: State a hypothesis and rule out at least one alternative
why: Prevents guessing and repeating last time's fix.

step: Inform supervisor and request a stop
why: Production must know before the line stops.
Isolates hazardous energy before anyone touches the machine.

step: Inspect the bearing and grease condition
why: Confirms or refutes the hypothesis physically.
Regrease, purge, or replace depending on diagnosis.
Only after tools are cleared and people are clear of moving parts.
The fix is not done until the data says so.
